tha-ap442:1.1: Jambuphaliya.] Padumuttarabuddhassa lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / piṇḍāya vicarantassa dhārato uttamaṃ yasaṃ // //
tha-ap442:2.1: Aggaphalaṃ gahetvāna vippasannena cetasā / dakkhiṇeyyassa vīrassa adāsiṃ satthuno ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap442:3.1: Tena kammena dipadinda lokajeṭṭha narāsabha / patto 'mhi acalaṃ ṭhānaṃ hitvā jayaparājayaṃ. // //
tha-ap442:4.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi aggadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap442:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Jambuphaliyo thero i. g. a-ti. Jambuphaliyattherassa
tha-ap442:12.1: Thero-Ekavihārī ca Saṅkhiko Pāṭihīrako Thaviko Ucchukaṇḍī ca Kalamb' Ambāṭakapadā
tha-ap442:13.1: Harīṭak' Ambapiṇḍī ca Jambudo dasamo yati chalāsītiñ ca gāthāyo gaṇitāyo vibhāvihīti.
